templates.question: Please provide the approved Indian maximum retail price (MRP incl. of all taxes).
templates.context: Legal Metrology Rule 6(1)(e) requires an explicit MRP declaration in Indian Rupees. PackSignal will not fabricate price data.
templates.impact: Unblocks MRP declaration block on Back panel and enables Unit Sale Price (USP) arithmetic.

templates.question: Please provide the 14-digit FSSAI Manufacturing / Importer Licence Number.
templates.context: FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Reg. 5(7) mandates the 14-digit licence identifier on the label.
templates.impact: Populates statutory FSSAI licence block contiguous to the FSSAI wordmark.

templates.question: Please provide the complete Consumer Grievance / Care Contact details.
templates.context: Legal Metrology Rule 6(1)(f) requires Name, Address, Telephone, and Email of the consumer care contact.
templates.impact: Completes mandatory Consumer Care block on the Back panel.

templates.question: Does this product have statutory FSSAI Vegan Logo endorsement approval?
templates.context: FSSAI Vegan Foods Regulations 2022 mandate prior FSSAI registration. Private vegan marks are not statutory proof in India, and honey is an animal-derived ingredient.
templates.impact: Determines whether the FSSAI Vegan Logo may appear or whether vegan claims must be removed.
templates.defaultAnswer: No official FSSAI vegan endorsement; remove vegan claim/mark due to honey content.
